exact_statement: Every Boolean sign on the uniform cube with 1<=n<=4 admits one of its two all-prime-implicant tables, one ordered cover per conjunction (transported from an NPN representative), and lambda=1/read, for which the complete conditioned posterior partition-forest residual R is at most (1421029/1000000) I. Moreover for n<=2, in the class of all-prime-implicant tables with one complete support order per conjunction, optimizing BOTH orientations, EVERY positive packing weight and EVERY gate order, the maximum residual/influence infimum is exactly 3/10, attained by the two-bit point defect. Constants have R=I=0. No all-dimensional conclusion or weight-infimum lower bound for n=3,4 is asserted.

exact_statement: For any fixed finite ordered support table with positive pi, covering every positive-mass nonempty Fourier set, and any fixed positive packing vector mu, the complete optimal posterior partition-forest residual obeys R(t mu)=D log2(1/t)+O(1) as t decreases to zero, where D=sum_{A nonempty} P_f(A)(d_A-1) and d_A is the minimum number of supports covering A. In particular D>0 forces divergence to +infinity. The remainder depends on the fixed table and direction; no partial-boundary or all-lambda infimum claim follows.
